admin_id.description: User id of the administrator who performed the action.

action.description: Machine action key, e.g. user.role_change, repeater.approve, report.resolve, settings.update.

target_type.description: Entity type of the affected record, e.g. User, Repeater, AdminReport.

target_label.description: Human-readable label for the target (email, callsign, name).

before.description: JSON snapshot of relevant fields before the change.

after.description: JSON snapshot of relevant fields after the change.

description.description: Optional free-form note describing this audit entry.
